mobbin:ee3075cd-af6e-4a12-b483-b0045f9f0.summary: From the hiring Benefits step, admin opens Equipment, adds a device (type, model, serial, condition, notes) when inventory is empty, and ends with the laptop assigned and status Pending shipping.
steal: Empty assign list (step 3): 'There are no devices to be assigned from your inventory' with Add New as the only path forward.
Device form (step 5): required Model + Serial/Unique ID with char limits; optional Condition; Notes helper 'These notes are shared with your worker.'
Post-assign state (step 6): item card shows type/model/serial plus Status = Pending shipping and note that shipping is marked later from device overview.
Assign flow gated Continue (step 3) stays disabled until a device is selected.
avoid: Embedding full item creation inside an unrelated multi-step hire wizard — inventory create/assign should be reachable from Assets itself, not only during onboarding.
mobbin:ee3075cd-af6e-4a12-b483-b0045f9f0.fit: Extends Essentials items + check-out-manual: typed assets with serial/condition and assign-to-person, plus an explicit logistics status for 'out for delivery' between storage and borrower.

mobbin:58cd5280-42c1-4bea-8d20-635fcbf3b.summary: Assets list with location-status overview opens a ThinkPad quick-view: Tracking (In storage, intake date, no service) then Asset details (IDs, condition, purchase/EOL).
steal: Location overview bar (step 1): With worker / In transit / In storage / Write off counts across total inventory.
List actions (step 1): Bulk import + Add asset; filters for Worker, storage locations, Category; Quick view per row.
Tracking tab (step 2): Location badge In storage, named storage site, Storage intake date; empty service state offers send to storage / assign / retire.
Asset details (step 3): Asset ID + Serial with copy; Condition; Purchase date; End of life date (even when Not specified).
mobbin:58cd5280-42c1-4bea-8d20-635fcbf3b.fit: Strong items pattern for Essentials asset registry: status distribution, quick drawer with tracking vs identity, lifecycle dates — lighter than Enterprise Inventory Manager counting but richer than a flat list.
